title: Intervals.icu Activity Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift/TrainingPeaks exports.
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as files.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=intervalsicu:activity
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by athlete_id
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>12
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Intervals.icu activity data has stopped arriving for a given athlete.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per athlete and alert when the feed is older than 12 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It helps keep when one part of your Intervals.icu activity feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
